title: Product and Platform Security Specialist
description:
Product and Platform Security Specialist Do you enjoy working out how code, pipelines and cloud platforms connect, and closing the gaps between them Would you like your work to protect every product at once Join our team Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet. We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to secure the systems our software is built, shipped and run on. The role finds and reduces security risk along the path from a code commit to a running workload. That path covers source control, build and deployment pipelines, artifact registries, container platforms and cloud accounts. You will work with platform, cloud security and product security teams on controls that every product inherits. You will also shape how AI agents are used safely inside the delivery pipeline. You will suit this role if you have built or run pipelines, clusters or cloud environments yourself and can think like an attacker about how they connect. Hands-on experience across identity, CI/CD, containers and cloud infrastructure matters more than depth in any one tool. Partner with the best as a Product and Platform Security Specialist you will be responsible for: Source control and pipeline security Assess how source control organizations, repositories and build pipelines are configured, and find the paths an attacker could take to production. Review access, tokens, apps and integrations, and reduce standing privileges. Define and enforce baseline rules for protected branches, code review and pipeline permissions. Harden runners and build environments against untrusted code. Deployment and container platform security Review deployment systems and GitOps controllers: who can deploy what, where, and with which credentials. Assess cluster access, workload isolation, admission policy, secrets handling and network segmentation. Make sure only trusted, traceable artifacts reach production. Work with platform teams to fix findings and track them to closure. Cloud foundations and identity Review how pipelines and workloads obtain cloud access, and replace stored keys with short-lived, federated identity. Assess account structure, organization-level guardrails and infrastructure as code for gaps. Keep an inventory of machine identities and what each one can do. Agree with the cloud security team who owns each finding on cloud resources. Automation, policy as code and monitoring Write scripts that collect configuration evidence from platform APIs, so assessments can be repeated. Express controls as code, so they are versioned, reviewed and tested. Define the audit logs each platform must send to central monitoring and build detections for risky changes. Support the response to software supply chain and platform incidents. AI agent and developer platform security Assess the risks of AI coding assistants and agents that act inside repositories, pipelines and cloud environments. Define guardrails for what agents can read, change and connect to, including their identities and tool integrations. Review developer environments that hold credentials for these platforms. Track new attack techniques against AI agents, pipelines and software supply chains. Engineering enablement Publish clear standards, reference configurations and guidance for platform and product teams. Coach engineers on secure pipeline, container and cloud practices. Report risk and progress to leadership in plain terms. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role you will : Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns: Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive Working with us A degree in computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum 8 years in platform security, cloud security, DevSecOps, infrastructure or site reliability engineering. Hands-on experience securing or running source control and CI/CD p latforms used by many teams. Experience securing container platforms and cloud-native workloads. Working knowledge of at least one major public cloud: its identity and policy model, networking and organization-level guardrails. Sound understanding of identity: federated sign-in, role-based access and workload identity. Scripting or programming skill in at least one language, and ease with APIs and the command line. Knowledge of common attack paths against pipelines, clusters and cloud accounts, and of software supply chain risks. Technical skills Source control and CI/CD Organization and repository governance, branch protection and review rules Pipeline permissions, secrets, runners and third-party pipeline components Artifact signing, provenance and registry controls Containers and orchestration Cluster authentication and role-based access control Workload isolation and admission policy Network policy and secrets management Image scanning and runtime detection Cloud and identity Cloud identity and access management, and organization-level policy Short-lived, federated credentials for workloads and pipelines Infrastructure as code and policy as code Audit logging and detection AI security AI agent identity, permissions and sandboxing Prompt injection and misuse of agent tools Guardrails for AI-assisted development The supply chain of models, tools and connectors Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities Comprehensive private medical care options Safety net of life insurance and disability programs Tailored financial programs Additional elected or voluntary benefits The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Product Security 

 Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in full-stack application development on AWS, with proven ability to lead development teams, drive architectural decisions across frontend (React/Angular with Amplify) and backend (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB/RDS) layers, and establish CI/CD standards. Key Responsibilities Lead full-stack application development using React/Angular (with Amplify and Next.js/Nuxt), Java/Python/Node.js, and AWS serverless services. Architect end-to-end solutions including frontend (CloudFront CDN distribution), backend (Lambda, Lambda MicroVMs, Lambda Managed Instances), API (API Gateway, AppSync for GraphQL), and database layers (DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache). Design scalable REST and GraphQL API architectures using API Gateway and AppSync with advanced patterns (caching, WebSocket, request/response transformations). Lead database design and optimization for DynamoDB (single-table design, GSI/LSI) and RDS/Aurora workloads. Establish CI/CD pipeline standards using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and Amplify Hosting with managed CI/CD. Lead and mentor development teams on modern frameworks, TypeScript full-stack patterns, and AWS best practices. Collaborate with DevOps, Security, QA, and business teams for delivery excellence. Use CloudWatch, X-Ray, CloudTrail, and CloudWatch Logs Insights for observability and performance optimization. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 10+ years of experience in software engineering. 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience. Deep proficiency in frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) and backend technologies (Java, Python, Node.js/TypeScript). Extensive experience designing REST and GraphQL APIs with API Gateway, AppSync, and serverless patterns. Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda (Functions, MicroVMs), S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Cognito, IAM. Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines at scale using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and Amplify. Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK). Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, Fargate). Strong understanding of application security (Cognito, IAM, KMS, WAF) and cloud governance. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of Agile Methodology and Practices. Prior experience with microservices architecture and event-driven design. Nice to Have AWS Professional or Associate certifications. Experience with AI tools in development lifecycles (GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, Amazon Q Developer) and brought in efficiencies.
